title: yadgar/iam
$comment: Closure is PER CHART (ADR-0850): this file closes the key set this chart owns and nothing upstream or downstream of it. `additionalProperties: false` sits at the root and at every declared block, so a misspelled key anywhere in the tree is refused by name instead of silently dropped or silently accepted. OPEN (no `properties`, no closure): `global`, because helm injects it into every subchart whether the parent sets it or not and this chart never reads it; `resources` and `rollingUpdate`, because the shape they take is the Kubernetes API's and this chart only forwards it through `toYaml`/`with`. EXTRAS (leaves `chart/values.yaml` never states, read straight off the templates): `image.digest`, rewritten at package time by ci-release (D65), read in `templates/deployment.yaml`; `networkPolicy.scrapeFrom.namespace`, read in `templates/networkpolicy.yaml`, with `values.yaml` shipping the parent block `scrapeFrom: {}` empty. Types, toggle shapes and `required` are NOT this file's job (ADR-0847): `render-checks.yaml` owns them, and `autoscaling`/`autoscaling.enabled`'s `kindIs` guards (ledger 1135) are the worked example — a schema `type` on either would refuse the chart's own default render the day the value changed shape, which is why every leaf here is `{}`.
